tool_schemas.name: execute_command
tool_schemas.description: Executes a terminal command in a managed session and returns the session metadata (including PID) plus any output produced before the optional timeout; if the timeout elapses, the process continues running and can be polled with read_output. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if command is empty/invalid or timeout_ms is not a number, FORBIDDEN if the command matches a blacklisted rule or violates safety policy, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if session/concurrency limits are reached. Raises CONFLICT if a new session cannot be started due to the workspace being in a non-runnable state, and INTERNAL_ERROR if the process fails to spawn.

tool_schemas.name: read_output
tool_schemas.description: Returns any new stdout/stderr output collected since the last read for the given session PID, along with updated session status if it has exited, timed out, failed, or been terminated. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if pid is missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the PID does not correspond to a known Desktop Commander session, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to access the session’s workspace. Raises CONFLICT if the session is not in a readable state (e.g., not yet created), and INTERNAL_ERROR on collector/stream failures.

tool_schemas.name: force_terminate
tool_schemas.description: Forcefully terminates the command session identified by PID and returns the updated session record reflecting the terminated state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if pid is missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the PID is not a managed session, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to control the session. Raises CONFLICT if the session has already exited/failed/been terminated and cannot transition to terminated, and INTERNAL_ERROR if the OS refuses the termination signal.

tool_schemas.name: list_sessions
tool_schemas.description: Lists terminal sessions, optionally filtered by workspace_id and/or lifecycle status, returning a paged result set ordered by the requested sort with up to limit items and a next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid workspace_id format, unsupported status/sort values, or out-of-range limit, and FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to enumerate sessions for the requested workspace scope. Raises NOT_FOUND if the provided workspace_id does not exist, and INTERNAL_ERROR if the session index cannot be queried.

workspace_id.description: Filter sessions to a specific workspace id (ULID).

limit.description: Maximum number of sessions to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of sessions.

tool_schemas.name: list_processes
tool_schemas.description: Lists currently running OS processes visible to Desktop Commander and returns a paged result set (up to limit) including per-process metadata such as PID, command name, CPU, and memory, plus a next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for out-of-range limit or unsupported sort, and FORBIDDEN if process enumeration is disallowed by the active safety policy. Raises INTERNAL_ERROR if the process table cannot be read.

limit.description: Maximum number of processes to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of processes.

tool_schemas.name: kill_process
tool_schemas.description: Forcefully terminates the OS process with the specified PID and returns the termination result/status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if pid is missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if no running process exists with that PID, and FORBIDDEN if the safety policy disallows killing processes or the target is protected. Raises CONFLICT if the process is already exiting or cannot be signaled in its current state, and INTERNAL_ERROR if the OS kill operation fails.

tool_schemas.name: block_command
tool_schemas.description: Creates or updates a blocked-command rule for the provided command string so subsequent execute_command calls matching it are refused. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if command is empty/invalid, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to modify safety controls in the current workspace scope. Raises CONFLICT if an identical rule already exists in the same scope with the same status, and INTERNAL_ERROR if the rule cannot be persisted.

tool_schemas.name: unblock_command
tool_schemas.description: Marks the blocked-command rule for the provided command string as unblocked so it is no longer refused by execute_command. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if command is empty/invalid, NOT_FOUND if no matching blocked-command rule exists to unblock, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to modify safety controls. Raises CONFLICT if the rule is already unblocked, and INTERNAL_ERROR if the update fails.

tool_schemas.name: list_blocked_commands
tool_schemas.description: Lists blocked-command rules, optionally filtered by workspace_id and status, returning a paged result set ordered by sort with up to limit items and a next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid workspace_id format, unsupported status/sort values, or out-of-range limit, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to view safety controls for the requested scope. Raises NOT_FOUND if the provided workspace_id does not exist, and INTERNAL_ERROR if rules cannot be queried.

workspace_id.description: Filter blocked commands to a specific workspace id (ULID).

status.description: Filter by blocked command rule status.

limit.description: Maximum number of blocked command rules to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of blocked command rules.

sort.description: Sort order for returned blocked command rules.

tool_schemas.name: read_file
tool_schemas.description: Reads and returns the full contents of the specified path, either from the local filesystem (restricted to allowlisted directories) or from a URL when isUrl=true; binary/image content is returned in a viewable/encoded form and text is returned as text. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if path is empty/invalid or isUrl is not a boolean, FORBIDDEN if the filesystem path is outside the allowlist or violates safety policy, and NOT_FOUND if the file/URL resource does not exist. Raises CONFLICT if the path refers to an unsupported type (e.g., directory) for this operation, and INTERNAL_ERROR on I/O or fetch failures.

tool_schemas.name: read_multiple_files
tool_schemas.description: Reads the contents of each path in `paths` and returns an array of per-path results containing the resolved path plus content when readable (text is returned as text; PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP images are returned as viewable image content), continuing past individual failures. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `paths` is missing/empty or contains non-string entries, FORBIDDEN if any path is outside the allowlist, and NOT_FOUND when a requested path does not exist (reported per file rather than aborting the whole call). Raises CONFLICT when a path refers to a directory instead of a file, and INTERNAL_ERROR for unexpected I/O failures reading an allowed file.

tool_schemas.name: write_file
tool_schemas.description: Completely replace file contents. Best for large changes (>20% of file) or when edit_block fails. Use with caution as it will overwrite existing files. Only works within allowed directories.

tool_schemas.name: create_directory
tool_schemas.description: Creates the directory at `path`, including any missing parent directories, and returns the created/ensured directory path. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `path` is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if `path` is outside the allowlisted directories, and CONFLICT if a non-directory entry already exists at `path`. Raises INTERNAL_ERROR if the directory cannot be created due to underlying filesystem errors (for example permissions or read-only volume).

tool_schemas.name: list_directory
tool_schemas.description: Lists the immediate children of the directory at `path` and returns a detailed listing that distinguishes entries as files or directories (e.g., with [FILE]/[DIR] markers). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `path` is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if `path` is outside the allowlist, NOT_FOUND if the directory does not exist, and CONFLICT if `path` exists but is not a directory. Raises INTERNAL_ERROR on unexpected filesystem enumeration failures.

tool_schemas.name: move_file
tool_schemas.description: Moves or renames the filesystem entry at `source` to `destination` and returns the final destination path. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `source`/`destination` are missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if either path is outside the allowlist, and NOT_FOUND if `source` does not exist. Raises CONFLICT if `destination` already exists or if the move is otherwise refused by the filesystem (including invalid cross-device moves where unsupported), and INTERNAL_ERROR for unexpected I/O failures.

tool_schemas.name: search_files
tool_schemas.description: Recursively searches under `path` for file/directory names containing `pattern` (case-insensitive substring match) and returns matching paths; the operation stops when the timeout is reached (default 30s, configurable with `timeoutMs`). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `path`/`pattern` are missing/invalid or if `timeoutMs` is not a valid number, FORBIDDEN if `path` is outside the allowlist, and NOT_FOUND if the starting path does not exist. Raises TIMEOUT when the search exceeds the effective timeout, and INTERNAL_ERROR for unexpected traversal errors.

tool_schemas.name: search_code
tool_schemas.description: Runs a ripgrep-based content search under `path` for `pattern` and returns matches (optionally constrained by `filePattern`, `ignoreCase`, `includeHidden`, `contextLines`, and capped by `maxResults`), stopping early when limits or timeout are hit (default 30s, configurable with `timeoutMs`). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid or if numeric options (e.g., `maxResults`, `contextLines`, `timeoutMs`) are out of range, FORBIDDEN if `path` is outside the allowlist, and NOT_FOUND if the starting path does not exist. Raises TIMEOUT when the search exceeds the effective timeout, and INTERNAL_ERROR if the underlying search process fails unexpectedly.

tool_schemas.name: get_file_info
tool_schemas.description: Returns metadata for the filesystem entry at `path` including type (file vs directory), size, timestamps, and permissions. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `path` is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if `path` is outside the allowlist, and NOT_FOUND if the entry does not exist. Raises INTERNAL_ERROR for unexpected stat/permission inspection failures.

tool_schemas.name: list_allowed_directories
tool_schemas.description: Returns the effective directory allowlist for the server, or for the specified `workspace_id` when provided. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `workspace_id` is present but does not match the expected ULID format, NOT_FOUND if the referenced workspace does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to view that workspace’s allowlist. Returns an empty list when no directories are allowed.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (ULID) to return allowed directories for; if omitted, returns the server's effective allowlist.

tool_schemas.name: edit_block
tool_schemas.description: Applies an exact-search/replace edit described by `blockContent` (filepath plus a single <<<<<<< SEARCH / ======= / >>>>>>> REPLACE block), verifies the change, and returns the updated file contents or an edit result confirming the applied patch. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the block format is invalid or missing required markers, FORBIDDEN if the target filepath is outside the allowlist, and NOT_FOUND if the target file does not exist. Raises CONFLICT when the SEARCH text does not match the current file content (or matches ambiguously) or when the target is not a regular file, and INTERNAL_ERROR for unexpected write/verification failures.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_identity
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity for Desktop Commander, including subject identifiers, granted scopes, active workspace context (if any), and current quota/rate-limit consumption. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no valid credentials are presented and FORBIDDEN if the credential is valid but not entitled to use this service.

api_key.description: Desktop Commander API key used to authenticate the request; if omitted, the server attempts to use the default credential configured for the runtime.

tool_schemas.name: list_workspaces
tool_schemas.description: Lists workspaces visible to the caller, optionally filtered by lifecycle status and name query, returning a paged result set ordered by the requested sort with up to limit items and a next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for unsupported status/sort values or out-of-range limit, and FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to enumerate workspaces.

api_key.description: Desktop Commander API key used to authenticate the request; if omitted, the server attempts to use the default credential configured for the runtime.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring match applied to workspace name.

limit.description: Maximum number of workspaces to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of workspaces.

tool_schemas.name: create_workspace
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new workspace with an allowlist of directories and default/max safety limits used for terminal and filesystem operations. Returns the created workspace record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid (including invalid paths), and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to create workspaces.

api_key.description: Desktop Commander API key used to authenticate the request; if omitted, the server attempts to use the default credential configured for the runtime.

allowed_directories.description: Absolute directory paths that bound filesystem access for this workspace.

default_command_timeout_ms.description: Default timeout applied by execute_command when timeout_ms is omitted.

default_search_timeout_ms.description: Default timeout applied by search operations when timeout_ms is omitted.

max_command_timeout_ms.description: Maximum allowed command timeout for this workspace.

max_search_timeout_ms.description: Maximum allowed search timeout for this workspace.

max_search_results.description: Maximum number of search results allowed for code/file search operations.

tool_schemas.name: update_workspace
tool_schemas.description: Updates workspace configuration and/or transitions its lifecycle status. Returns the updated workspace record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid fields (including invalid paths), FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized, and CONFLICT if the requested status transition is not allowed (active↔suspended, active/suspended→deleted only).

api_key.description: Desktop Commander API key used to authenticate the request; if omitted, the server attempts to use the default credential configured for the runtime.

status.description: New lifecycle status for the workspace; invalid transitions are refused.

allowed_directories.description: Replaces the workspace allowlist of directories.

max_command_timeout_ms.description: Replaces the maximum allowed command timeout (ms).

max_search_timeout_ms.description: Replaces the maximum allowed search timeout (ms).

max_search_results.description: Replaces the maximum allowed search results.

tool_schemas.name: list_fs_operations
tool_schemas.description: Lists filesystem operation audit records, optionally filtered by workspace, op_type, and lifecycle status, returning a paged result set ordered by the requested sort with up to limit items and a next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters/sort/limit, and FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to view filesystem audit logs for the workspace.

api_key.description: Desktop Commander API key used to authenticate the request; if omitted, the server attempts to use the default credential configured for the runtime.

workspace_id.description: Filter operations to a specific workspace id (ULID).

limit.description: Maximum number of operations to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of operations.
